questions.prompt: Why does the closure in files/broken.rs fail to compile?

options.a: Threads are inherently unsafe in Rust
options.b: It borrows log by reference, but the thread could outlive that borrow — a data race the compiler refuses

questions.prompt: What are the two safe ways to provide data to a spawned thread?

options.b: Move ownership into the thread, or share it behind Arc/Mutex — never a bare reference borrow
